body: A reviewed PSD-COPY-CANCELLATION-DESIGN.md at 8363c8a. Approve typed prepare/cancel/run, snapshot-on-run committed state, origin-owned Swift completion, weak identity registry, cancellation before backend lock, and linearized commit admission before unlocked persist. Implement the bounded operation/host slice source-only in a separate commit, with tiny tests UNRUN for A. Important correction: accepting cancellation of a Running copy must NOT release per-document admission until that run actually exits; otherwise a retry can overlap the opaque encoder and defeat one-copy resource containment. Track cancellation-requested separately from terminal/drained phase. A cancelled Prepared handle can allow a fresh prepare only if its old later run remains pre-cancelled and cannot evaluate; run is single-use. Add a gated draining-cancel/second-prepare rejection test and fresh-prepare success after unwind. Keep no locks over evaluation, copying, callbacks or persist. Boundary-only compositor conversion and encoder limits must remain explicit; this operation slice is not whole-PSD cancellation acceptance. A will separately implement cancellable merged-composite/channel conversion in compositor before claiming useful end-to-end cancellation. Do not change compositor or engine-api in your slice; leave a narrow reviewed handoff for A. Preserve compatibility wrapper and destination sentinel/commit-race tests from design. No B build, bindings generation, test/app/benchmark or heartbeat restart; A will compile generated Swift and current mocks. Main remains A-owned. Also note A frame/cache gate found missing dropped-frame telemetry; A is repairing, so do not duplicate render.rs changes. Current main4090aeb7 has details; viewport already merged1c0f36b8.
